name: Sparkline
tagline: A trend over ordered values, small enough to sit in a sentence.
summary: Weekly revenue. Trending up 200%. Range 3 to 9. Last value 9.

name: SparkBar
tagline: Compact bars for magnitude, or a win–loss streak of outcomes.
summary: Deploys per day. Trending up 125%. Range 2 to 9. Last value 9.

name: ForecastCone
tagline: Will we land where we need to?
summary: Q4 revenue. Median forecast 42 by week 11 (80% between 33 and 55), from 38 today. The 80% band straddles the 45 target.

name: Bullet
tagline: A measure against a target and qualitative bands.
summary: Quota. 72 of 80 target.

name: ActivityGrid
tagline: Calendar or matrix intensity: the contribution-graph shape.
summary: Commits. Total 67 over 35 periods. Busiest 4.

name: TrendArrow
tagline: Which way is this moving? At glyph size, before any number.
summary: Latency vs last week. Down 0.08.

name: StatusDot
tagline: What state is this thing in: shape and color paired, never color alone.
summary: API. Status: ok.

name: Progress
tagline: How far along, exactly: bar plus the percent that is the datum.
summary: Onboarding. 68% complete.

name: RugStrip
tagline: Where the raw observations actually sit: distribution without binning.
summary: Pay band. 20 values from 42 to 83, median 58.

name: MiniBar
tagline: Which category is biggest, and by roughly how much.
summary: Sales by region. 4 categories. Highest East 940, lowest North 120.

name: PictogramRow
tagline: Counts a human can verify by counting: ●●●○○.
summary: Committee seats held. 5 of 8.

name: Seismogram
tagline: When did things happen, and how hard: event density over time.
summary: Error bursts. 29 events, peak 11.

name: HeatStrip
tagline: How intensity evolved, glanceably: the 1×N sibling of ActivityGrid.
summary: Load per hour. Trending up 192%. Range 12 to 90. Last value 35.

name: DotPlot
tagline: A few named values on one scale: minimum ink per comparison.
summary: Review scores. 5 categories. Highest Ada 96, lowest Kim 41.

name: Dumbbell
tagline: Where each row started and ended: hollow to filled, no legend.
summary: Band move. From 62,000 to 84,000, up 35%.

name: Slope
tagline: Who rose and who fell between two moments: crossings read instantly.
summary: Before vs after. 5 categories: 3 up, 2 down. Largest change Mid, up 75%.

name: MicroScatter
tagline: Are these two variables related? The relationship no other type tells.
summary: Latency vs error rate. 24 points. Strong positive relationship (r 0.93).

name: SegmentedBar
tagline: What is this made of, and in what proportions.
summary: Browser share. Chrome 62%, Safari 24%, Firefox 9%, Edge 3%, Arc 2%.

name: HistogramStrip
tagline: What does the distribution look like? Mode, spread, skew in a cell.
summary: Response times. 120 values, most between 42.09 and 47.36.

name: MicroBox
tagline: The p50 and spread of a metric: a five-number summary in a row.
summary: p95 latency. Median 42, middle half 35 to 51, range 12 to 96.

name: ProgressRing
tagline: How complete is this? At icon size, where a bar doesn't fit.
summary: Backup. 68% complete.

name: MicroDonut
tagline: Roughly what is this made of? An honest, capped concession at icon size.
summary: Traffic mix. Chrome 62%, Safari 24%, Firefox 9%, Other 5%.

name: Funnel
tagline: Where does the pipeline leak? Stage-to-stage conversion in a cell.
summary: Signup funnel. 4 stages, 12,400 to 1,116 — overall 9%.

name: Waterfall
tagline: How the deltas compose into the total: P&L in a cell.
summary: Net income bridge. From 60 to 87 over 5 steps: +65 gains, −38 losses.

name: Horizon
tagline: A wide-range series folded into a slim, dense band.
summary: Cluster load. Trending up 900%. Range 2 to 45. Last value 20.

name: TallyMarks
tagline: How many, counted the way a human counts.
summary: Signatures. 23 counted.

name: DicePips
tagline: A small count or severity, read instantly as a die face.
summary: Severity. 4 out of 6.

name: MoonPhase
tagline: How far through a cycle or period: readable across cultures.
summary: Sprint. 68% of the cycle complete.

name: Hourglass
tagline: How much time is gone and how much remains, both at once.
summary: Session. 75% elapsed, 25% remaining.

name: Honeycomb
tagline: How many of the available slots are taken.
summary: Occupancy. 34 of 40 seats filled.

name: Constellation
tagline: When the rare events happened, and how big.
summary: Incidents. 4 events between 0 and 8; largest at 2.

name: TreeRings
tagline: How growth accumulated, period over period, from the centre out.
summary: Account age. 8 years; latest 14, biggest 22 in year 5.

name: CitySkyline
tagline: How groups compare on size, and how activated each is.
summary: Team sizes. 5 teams; tallest Platform at 46.

name: MusicStaff
tagline: The shape of a short series, read as a melody.
summary: Sprint melody. Trending up 267%. Range 3 to 11. Last value 11.

name: Thermometer
tagline: Where a value sits on a calibrated range, and how close to the goal.
summary: Fundraiser. 72 on a 0–100 scale; target 80.

name: BalanceBeam
tagline: Which of two sides outweighs, and roughly by how much.
summary: Inflow 620 vs Outflow 480; Inflow heavier.

name: WindBarb
tagline: Which way it's flowing and roughly how hard, in one character.
summary: Wind. Southwest (225°), magnitude 32.

name: WinProbWorm
tagline: Who's winning, and when did the lead flip?
summary: Win probability. Per the supplied model, home leads at 98%; 3 lead changes, biggest swing +17 at point 8.

name: Waveform
tagline: The shape of a high-frequency signal, where its spikes and silences are, at word width.
summary: Voice memo. Peak 0.738 at 63% through 200 samples.

name: QuadrantDot
tagline: Where does it sit in the 2×2?
summary: Effort vs impact. Impact 9, effort 3 — in the high-impact, low-effort quadrant (2 of 14 peers).
